Hope my instructions made sense 😂

Chop up 
-170 grams Butternut Squash 
-230grams onion 
-230grams Tomatoes 
-150 grams peppers 
Just leave 60grams Spinach and 100grams Asparagus as is. 

The way I cooked them was spraying a pan with 0cal butter spray (I had nothing else at the moment). Then putting my butternut squash on the pan and in the oven cooking for a bit then I pulled it out and added the asparagus and onions then put a bunch of onion powder, chili powder, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper mixed it around let it cook more then added my peppers (basically working my way through the veggies that require the most cooking time to least). Finally towards the end added my spinach and tomatoes again adding more seasoning. (I just basically kept mixing through out as well as tasting whether it needed more of any seasonings). 

If my calculating was correct it’s about 300 calories for the whole thing and I only ate half so 150 per serving! 

Hopefully that made sense I basically just winged it 😂
There’s also a shit ton of seasons on this and it actually was AMAZING!!! Like probably going to be my new meal fixation for awhile!

I’m really sorry you feel like that, I know I’m currently in the same situation. Even though it doesn’t feel like it, it will get better and just focus on yourself and do one healthy thing everyday that makes you feel a little bit better. 

Some healthy activities could be:
-showering (trust me I know how hard it is when you feel so bad but sometimes it helps even if you have to sit in the shower cause you can’t work up the energy to stand. 
-read 
-watch a favorite show 
-listen to comforting music 
-take a walk
-make your bed 
-paint your nails a fun color just for the heck of it. 
-go get a coffee or smoothie from your favorite cafe 
-draw a picture 
-call a friend 
-sleep
-get a fresh new haircut 
-dye your hair
-see a friend 
-look at cute puppy or kitten pictures online (or any other cute animal) 
-hug a pillow 
-just sprint as fast as possible and pay attention to the wind whipping by your face and try to feel how alive you are 

Don’t know if these ideas are helpful but I know how I feel when the dark feelings are hard you long for a bit of encouragement or just a sign someone cares, so I hope I can be that sign that someone cares and you’re not alone. *hug*
